_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Saying silent letters and extra syllables

items.native: Say it like the word close.

segments.text: Four words many people say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.caption: Do you say every letter? Not in these words: “island”, “clothes”, “castle” and “listen” all hide a sound. Listen to Carlos, then say each word in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
